# Suluk

> Suluk = an OpenAPI v4.0 candidate spec + a contracts-in/everything-derived TypeScript framework: the @suluk/* packages (the npm logic) and a shadcn registry of own-the-code backend modules (the app-owned wiring).

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

## @suluk/admin

### API

- `adminApp`: Build the /superadmin Hono app. Mount it on your server: `app.route("/", adminApp({...}))`.
- `layout`
- `renderCycle`
- `renderBuilder`
- `renderChecks`
- `renderDeploy`
- `esc`
- `entityModels`: Project a v4 document's component schemas into admin entity models (fields + per-CRUD access scope), sorted.
- `renderEntityForm`: A create/edit form for an entity, derived from its schema. `id` is omitted on create (DB-assigned).
- `renderEntityTable`: A list table for an entity — a column per field; `rows` are optional sample data to fill it.
- `renderDataIndex`: The data-admin index: every CRUD-managed entity + its access scopes, linking to its per-entity page.
- `renderEntityAdmin`: One entity's data-admin page — a FULLY FUNCTIONAL CRUD UI (saastarter's Payload admin, projected): a live list
table (loaded from the entity's CRUD...
- `renderAnalytics`: Render the analytics dashboard for a document.

## Optional

### Types

- `EntityModel`
- `EntityField`
- `EntityAccess`

## @suluk/agents

### API

- `lintAgents`: `@suluk/agents` — the Suluk Agent composition layer (C027).
- `lintOk`: True ⇒ no error-severity findings (warnings/info are advisory).
- `assertAgentInstallable`: Convenience: lint a single agent's existence + errors, throwing the first error (for fail-loud projection).
- `parsePointer`: Parse a `#/a/b~1c/d` fragment pointer into its decoded tokens (or null if not a local fragment pointer).
- `resolveOperationRef`: Resolve a route's `operationRef` to an EXISTING operation.
- `agentMap`: The agent map, or an empty record.
- `subAgentKey`: Decode a sub-agent ref `#/x-suluk-agents/<key>` to its key (or null if malformed / not an agent ref).
- `childKeys`: Direct sub-agent keys of an agent (decoded; may include dangling keys — the caller lint-checks existence).
- `findCycle`: Detect a cycle in the agent graph reachable from `root`, following by-name sub-agent refs.
- `subtreeDepth`: Longest sub-agent path depth below `root` (a leaf — no sub-agents — is depth 0).
- `deepStrings`: Every string value reachable in an object (for the request-value-selector D1 scan).
- `resolveInstruction`: Resolve a pinned instruction snapshot from an `instructions` map, accepting BOTH key conventions used across the
package: the QUALIFIED `"<agent>/<...
- `contentHash`: A short, stable content hash of an instructions snapshot.
- `renderSkillMd`: Render a Claude SKILL.
- `projectClaudePlugin`
- `projectOpenRouter`
- `projectCloudflareAgent`: Project an agent → an owned Cloudflare Agents-SDK scaffold + the Durable Object descriptors.
- `projectNodeAgent`: Project one agent → an owned Bun/Node agent-server scaffold. Pure, fail-loud.
- `routeToolDef`: Derive a route's tool-def from the contract (name + description + input schema + approval gate + paid-tool price).
- `paidToolPrice`: Derive an x402 `paidTool` price from an operation's declared `x-suluk-cost` (a `CostModel`, read STRUCTURALLY — no
`@suluk/cost` dep).
- `reachableSurface`: The statically-enumerable reachable surface of an agent: its own route keys (the wire ids) + every route key of
every transitively-reachable sub-ag...
- `residentSurface`: The RESIDENT surface of an agent (C027) — its own routes whose `tier` is not `cold-tail` (the default-visible
tool set).
- `residentToolNames`: The RESIDENT served-tool NAMES across an agent's whole REACHABLE surface (C027 tier-trim serving) — every route key
(the served wire id) whose `tie...
- `assertServedSubset`: OVER-SERVE auditor: assert the tools a server actually exposes are a SUBSET of the declared reachable surface.
- `assertServedSubsetGoverned`: POLICY-AWARE OVER-SERVE (C028): when an operator policy governs the agent, the served tools must be a subset of
the POST-POLICY effective surface —...
- `assertDefaultServedResident`: TIER-TRIM CONFORMANCE: the DEFAULT served tool set must contain NO cold-tail tool (those belong behind
`discover_tools`).
- `verifySkillFreshness`: SKILL-FRESHNESS: a skill's declared `provenance.
- `conformanceOk`: True ⇒ no error-severity conformance findings (warnings are advisory). Mirrors `lintOk` — the served-fact gate.
- `intersectScope`: INTERSECTION with null-as-unconstrained: ∩(null, X)=X, ∩(X, null)=X, ∩(X, Y)=X∩Y.
- `analyzeScopes`: Walk the agent tree from `root`, computing each reachable node's effective (intersected) scope and every per-edge
escalation.
- `localEscalations`: A LOCAL author-time escalation check for one agent's direct children: a child may not DECLARE a permission its
immediate parent does not grant (und...
- `agentManifest`: Build the canonical, signable manifest for an agent and its reachable sub-tree. Pure; does not throw.
- `verifyAgentFreshness`: Verify a signed manifest's skills against the CURRENT served snapshots: each skill's signed `contentHash` must
equal the hash of its current snapshot.
- `policyConstrain`: Apply ONE operator policy to an agent — a monotone MEET. Returns the narrowed envelope + an audit of every cut.
- `effectiveUnderPolicies`: Apply ALL governing policies to an agent (MEET is associative/commutative — compose left-to-right).
- `policiesFor`: All policies in the document that govern `agentKey`.
- `policyAppliesTo`: Does this policy govern `agentKey`? (empty/absent appliesTo ⇒ all agents.)
- `lintPolicy`: Lint every operator policy: D1 selector-rejection, dangling appliesTo, unsatisfiability, widening, cap<estimate.
- `policyOk`: True ⇒ no error-severity policy findings.
- `contextReport`: Compute the context-intelligence report (load + right-sizing + model fit) for every agent in the document.
- `suggestUnflatten`: When an agent is over its target, the cheapest decomposition: which resident tools to push to cold-tail.
- `resolveSkillModels`: Run the catalog selector for a skill from its declared NEEDS + the analyzer load.
- `skillModels`: The public seam: the models for a skill — its DECLARED list (opt-out) or the catalog-SELECTED ranked ids, resolved
to a runtime TARGET (pin / route...
- `deriveCQT`: cost_quality_tradeoff 0.
- `selectModel`
- `deriveRequirements`: Derive HardFilters from an agent/skill's declared needs + the analyzer's load (the C027 seam).
- `agentDiagram`: Build the agent's composition hierarchy. Cycle-safe: a back-edge on the current path becomes a marked leaf.
- `agentDiagramHtml`: Render the agent as ONE self-contained, interactive HTML page (collapsible + zoomable D3 tree).
- `gradeAgent`: Grade ONE agent A–F by aggregating the package's existing checks (+ two structure checks). Pure & static by default.
- `gradeAgents`: Grade EVERY agent in the document (weakest first) — the rollup. Computes the whole-doc passes ONCE (not per agent).
- `assertAgentGrade`: CI GATE (the hard incentive, mirrors `@suluk/harden`'s assertGrade): throw if the agent's grade is below `min`.
- `agentGradeOk`: True ⇒ the agent's grade is at least `min`.
- `gradeOf`: harden's letter thresholds, mirrored so the two grades share one ORDINAL scale (Stage 1.5 combines LETTERS).
- `agentLevel`: An agent's pyramid LEVEL: its composition height above the deterministic route-floor.
- `layerReport`: Build the whole-document pyramid view.
- `agenticPatterns`: The agentic patterns an agent's composition SHAPE affords (advisory; the runtime picks the actual trajectory).
- `affordedPatterns`: Convenience: just the pattern names an agent's shape affords (advisory).
- `resourceCatalog`: The agent's reachable loadable-resource catalog — its DIRECT `resources` refs resolved against the top-level map
(each sub-agent owns its own catal...
- `lintResources`: Lint the resources catalog + every agent's refs into it: catalog entries must be well-formed (description, valid
kind, pinned provenance), agent re...
- `resourcesOk`: True ⇒ no error-severity resource finding (the install-gate predicate for the resources facet).
- `resourceMap`: The top-level resources catalog (empty when absent).
- `resourceKey`: Decode a resource ref `#/x-suluk-resources/<key>` to its key (or null if malformed / not a resource ref).
- `runtimeProviders`: The runtime-provider registry. Add new targets here; the interface is the contract (mirrors `@suluk/deploy`'s `providers`).
- `cloudflareRuntime`: The Cloudflare adapter — wraps `projectCloudflareAgent` into the generic seam (its `durableObjects` → the deploy hint).
- `nodeRuntime`: The Node/Bun adapter — wraps `projectNodeAgent`. A plain long-lived process, so the deploy hint carries no infra.
- `SEED_CATALOG`: Illustrative seed — NOT the live catalog. Tiers reflect coarse public standing as of asOf; UNKNOWN is honest.
- `PROFILES`
- `FLOOR_LEVEL`: Routes — the deterministic floor — sit at level 0. The lowest an orchestrating agent can sit is level 1.

landed, per the C034 follow-up).

## @suluk/better-auth

### API

- `authSecuritySchemes`: Build v4 securitySchemes from the enabled Better Auth methods.
- `normalizeOas30`: Recursively rewrite OpenAPI-3.0 Schema-Object dialect into JSON Schema 2020-12.
- `ingestAuthOpenAPI`: Normalize + upgrade Better Auth's OpenAPI 3.0 schema to a v4 document (the auth surface).
- `mergeAuth`: Deep-merge auth paths + components (schemas + securitySchemes) into an app's v4 document.
- `principalFromSession`: Extract a { scopes } principal from a Better Auth session.
- `orgScope`: Build the org-namespaced scope `org:<orgId>:<action>` (the tenancy encoding).
- `parseOrgScope`: Parse an `org:<id>:<action>` scope back into its parts (null if it isn't one).
- `mountAuth`: Mount the Better Auth handler onto a Hono app under basePath/* (default /api/auth/*).
- `verifyApiKey`: Verify an API key (optionally requiring scopes) and return a `{ scopes }` Principal.
- `scopesToPermissions`: Flat scopes → Better Auth permissions.
- `permissionsToScopes`: Better Auth permissions → flat scopes.
- `parseApiKeyMetadata`: Safely parse key metadata, handling Better Auth's potential DOUBLE-stringification of the JSON field.
- `beforeDeleteCascade`: Build the Better Auth `user.
- `step`: A generic cascade step.
- `anonymizeStep`: An ANONYMIZE step — keep the row, scrub its PII (the FK-safe posture; recommended default).
- `deleteStep`: A hard-DELETE step — cascade-remove a subsystem's rows for the user.
- `isSafeRelativePath`: A path is safe to redirect to iff it's a SINGLE-leading-slash relative path (rejects "//host", "http(s)://…",
 backslash tricks, and protocol-relat...
- `resolveRedirectTo`: Read `redirectTo` from a query string / URLSearchParams; return it only if same-origin-relative, else `fallback`.
- `withRedirectTo`: Append a (guarded) `redirectTo` to an href — e.
- `emailVerificationConfig`: A Better Auth `emailVerification` block with frictionless-activation defaults.
- `previewLoginHandler`: Handle `GET /preview/login?
- `isPreviewRuntime`: True iff BOTH independent locks say "preview". Exported so callers/tests can assert the gate in isolation.
- `devLoginHandler`: Handle `POST /api/auth/dev-login` with `{ email }`.
- `MFA_SCOPE`: The scope a route requires to be sure the caller cleared their second factor (twoFactor plugin).
- `DEV_LOGIN_PASSWORD`: The fixed internal password the dev-login uses to drive email/password sign-up + sign-in. Not a real credential.

## Optional

### Types

- `AuthMethods`: `@suluk/better-auth` — official Better-Auth-on-Hono support for the Suluk derivation engine.
- `AuthSecurity`: `@suluk/better-auth` — official Better-Auth-on-Hono support for the Suluk derivation engine.
- `Principal`: The principal extractor — the loop-closer for per-viewer docs.
- `SessionLike`: A minimal view of a Better Auth session (duck-typed; works with the real Session shape).
- `AuthHandlerLike`: mountAuth — the thin Hono adapter for Better Auth (the documented integration:
app.
- `HonoLike`
- `ApiKeyVerifierLike`: A duck-typed view of Better Auth's server `verifyApiKey` (the app injects `betterAuth.api`).
- `VerifyApiKeyResult`
- `VerifiedKey`: The verified key's identity surface (metadata parsed via the double-stringification guard).
- `VerifyReason`
- `ApiKeyMetadata`: Metadata stored on a key for delegation tracking (saastarter metadata.ts:4-8).
- `CascadeStep`: One step of the erasure cascade — the erasure of one subsystem for one user.
- `PreviewRequestLike`: A minimal view of the Worker request — only `.url` (to read the `role` query param) is needed. Web `Request` satisfies it.
- `PreviewEnvLike`: The two independent locks live on the Worker env: a var and a binding. Duck-typed; extra keys ignored.
- `MintedSession`: What a successful mint returns: the headers to set on the redirect (e.g. the session Set-Cookie).
- `DevLoginAuthLike`: The Better Auth surface this needs — its public `signUpEmail`/`signInEmail` server endpoints. Duck-typed.

## @suluk/billing

### API

- `stripePost`: `@suluk/billing` — Stripe plumbing over an injected config (C046).
- `stripeGet`: `@suluk/billing` — Stripe plumbing over an injected config (C046).
- `toForm`: Stripe's bracket-nested `x-www-form-urlencoded` encoder: objects → `key[k]`, arrays → `key[i]`, scalars appended;
 undefined/null are skipped.
- `mockStripeFetch`: Build a mock Stripe `fetch`.
- `createCustomer`: Create a Stripe customer for the user (the caller persists the id).
- `createSetupIntent`: Create a $0 SetupIntent to vault a card without charging ("Add card"). Returns the client secret.
- `createPaymentIntent`: Create a PaymentIntent for an on-site one-time top-up (saves the card; the webhook credits it). Returns the client secret.
- `listPaymentMethods`: List a customer's saved cards (each with its billing address), marking the invoice default.
- `defaultCard`: The customer's DEFAULT saved card — its id (to charge) + its billing address (to locate tax).
- `defaultPaymentMethodId`: The customer's default payment-method id (to charge off-session), or null.
- `ownsPaymentMethod`: Whether `pmId` belongs to `customerId` — guards set-default / detach against another customer's card.
- `setDefaultPaymentMethod`: Make `pmId` the customer's default payment method for invoices.
- `setSubscriptionDefaultCard`: Point an ACTIVE subscription at `pmId` too, so changing the default card moves the recurring charge to it.
- `detachPaymentMethod`: Detach (remove) a saved card from the customer.
- `setSubscriptionCancel`: Schedule the subscription to cancel at the period end (`cancel=true`) or resume it (`cancel=false`).
- `payOpenInvoice`: Best-effort: if the subscription's latest invoice is still OPEN (a failed renewal), retry it NOW.
- `createCheckout`: Create a Stripe Checkout Session (one-time top-up) — the hosted FALLBACK to the on-site Payment Element.
- `createSubscriptionCheckout`: Stripe Checkout in SUBSCRIPTION mode (recurring). subscription_data.metadata carries who + how many credits/cycle.
- `createPortalSessionForCustomer`: Open the Stripe billing portal (manage/cancel) for an existing customer. Returns the URL; throws on a Stripe error.
- `createPaymentIntentOnDefaultCard`: Create a PaymentIntent on the customer's SAVED DEFAULT card — the one-click top-up path.
- `chargeOffSession`: An OFF-SESSION charge on a saved card (auto-top-up).
- `calculateTax`: Sales-tax / VAT for an on-site or auto top-up.
- `recordTaxTransaction`: Record a finished tax calculation as a Tax Transaction (the compliance/reporting step), keyed to a `reference`
 (e.
- `planById`: The app's plan whose id is `id`, or undefined — the generic lookup the orchestrators use against the injected catalog.
- `planByPrice`: The plan whose monthly price is exactly `priceCents` (each tier has a distinct price), or undefined — maps a live
 Stripe item price back to a plan...
- `ceilingFor`: The "paid ceiling" for the CURRENT cycle = the highest plan price already CHARGED this cycle.
- `ensurePlanPrice`: Find (by lookup_key) or create the recurring Stripe Price for a plan.
- `createSubscriptionOnDefaultCard`: Create a subscription ON the saved default card (one-click).
- `getSubscriptionStatus`
- `changeSubscriptionPlan`
- `billingCustomerId`: The user's Stripe customer id, or null when they have no billing account yet.
- `billingSubscriptionId`: The user's recorded Stripe subscription id, or null when they have no subscription.
- `linkBillingCustomer`: Persist the user's Stripe customer id WITHOUT touching subscriptionId — so a one-time top-up never clears a
 subscriber's `subscriptionId` (unlike ...
- `upsertBillingAccount`: Persist customer + subscription together (the subscribe path sets both). Idempotent on the userId PK.
- `clearSubscription`: Clear the recorded subscription (on customer.subscription.deleted) — leaves the customer id (+ its saved card) intact.
- `billingAccount`

## Optional

### Types

- `PaymentMethodWire`: A payment method as the billing panel shows it — card + its billing address + whether it's the customer's default.
- `TaxAddress`: A buyer's tax location (from a saved card's billing address).
- `CheckoutOpts`
- `SubscriptionCheckoutOpts`
- `TopupMeta`: The metadata tag the webhook reads to decide whether (and how) to credit a PaymentIntent.
- `TaxResult`
- `TaxLocation`: A buyer's tax location.
- `SubPlan`: A subscription plan as the app prices it — generic shape; the app derives `priceCents`/`credits` from its COGS model.
- `SubscriptionBranding`: Branding seam for the Stripe Product/Price a plan creates — app-controlled so find-or-create stays stable + on-brand.
- `SubscriptionStatus`: The user's CURRENT subscription as the UI needs it (plan + status + period end + pending-cancel + the cycle's paid
 ceiling), or null when there's ...
- `ChangePlanResult`: Change the subscriber's plan IN PLACE against the cycle's PAID CEILING (see ceilingFor).
- `BillingDB`: The injected DB handle. Prod is drizzle/d1; tests bridge drizzle/bun-sqlite to this type (a runtime-identity narrow).

## @suluk/builder

### API

- `isBind`: `@suluk/builder` — the tiered contract-narrowing DSL (components → blocks → sections → pages), bound to the
Suluk cycle.
- `isEach`: `@suluk/builder` — the tiered contract-narrowing DSL (components → blocks → sections → pages), bound to the
Suluk cycle.
- `isSlot`: `@suluk/builder` — the tiered contract-narrowing DSL (components → blocks → sections → pages), bound to the
Suluk cycle.
- `isListSpec`: `@suluk/builder` — the tiered contract-narrowing DSL (components → blocks → sections → pages), bound to the
Suluk cycle.
- `registry`: Build a registry from loose document lists + the set of leaf component names.
- `emptyRegistry`
- `findDoc`
- `allowedTypes`: The type names a document of `tier` is allowed to reference (its children come from COMPOSES[tier]).
- `resolveParams`: Effective param values: defaults, then a variant preset, then consumer props (only keys in `params`).
- `resolveList`: The effective ordered selection for a `list` param.
- `validateDocument`: Validate one document against the registry.
- `validateAll`: Validate every page / section / block in the registry.
- `renderPageTsx`
- `resolveComponents`: Ordered component names a page resolves to (section list → each section's block list → block===component).
- `crudRoutesFromSchema`: Generate backend CRUD RouteContracts from an entity's v4 schema (schemas → Zod for the bodies).
- `formBlock`: A Form block for an entity. Its contract (`params`) exposes only tone + which fields — the field SET is fixed.
- `tableBlock`: A Table block for an entity. Exposes tone + which columns.
- `crudSection`: A CRUD section composing the entity's Table + Form blocks.
- `appPage`: A page composing the given sections. Forwards tone; exposes only { sections, tone } upward.
- `buildApp`: Build the WHOLE app — backend (routes + v4) and frontend (components + pages) — from one declarative spec.
- `toShadcnRegistry`: Convert a BuiltApp into a shadcn registry: one "block" item per entity bundling its frontend components +
backend routes module + its v4 schema, pl...
- `installModule`: Merge a module's contract fragment into the app document — REFUSING on any collision or unmet requirement.
- `namespaceModule`: Resolve a collision by NAMESPACING a module: prefix its OWNED entities, rewrite internal $refs that point to
them, and remap auto-CRUD cost keys ac...
- `crudV4Paths`: The v4 CRUD operations for one entity, with $ref-based schemas (so the entity lives in components.schemas).
- `moduleOperations`: Every operation handle a module declares (auto-CRUD per provided entity + explicit ops).
- `gradeModule`: A conformance grade.
- `previewInstall`: Preview an install WITHOUT committing — what it adds, what it requires, any conflicts, and its grade.
- `schemaRefName`: The ROOT schema NAME a $ref targets, or null if it isn't a components/schemas reference.
- `resolveTemplate`: Resolve a template's module names to actual modules from a registry — REPORTING any name that doesn't resolve
 (a typo or a module missing from thi...
- `buildMarketing`: Build the marketing landing — sections + blocks + a page — from one spec. Synchronous: no fetch, no runtime.
- `marketingPage`: A landing page composing the given marketing sections — mirrors appPage (exposes only { tone, sections }).
- `seoMeta`: Resolve a seoMeta field-group: og* default to title/description, sensible card/type/locale defaults.
- `jsonLd`: Emit a schema.org JSON-LD object for an entity/page — drop it into a <script type="application/ld+json">.
- `planComposition`: Topologically order modules by `requires`/`provides`, modelling the collision invariants installModule enforces.
- `composeModules`: Install a set of modules in dependency order, returning the merged platform contract + a per-step trace.
- `providerFacets`: The facets the catalog knows about (payments, auth, email, storage).
- `readProviders`: The active provider bindings recorded in the document (from installed modules' providerSlots).
- `swapProvider`: Rebind a facet's slot to another implementation of the same interface. Returns the unchanged doc on error.
- `parseRegistry`: Parse an UNTRUSTED registry payload (e.g. fetched JSON) into a ModuleRegistry, rejecting malformed entries.
- `validateModule`: Validate one UNTRUSTED module manifest, VALUE-shapes included. Returns the typed module or a human reason.
- `signRegistry`: Sign a registry value with a private JWK → a base64 signature over its canonical bytes.
- `verifyRegistrySignature`: Verify a registry value against a base64 signature + a pinned public JWK. Never throws — false on any error.
- `generateSigningKeypair`: Generate an ECDSA P-256 keypair as JWKs (for tooling / tests — a publisher keeps the private key).
- `isSignedEnvelope`
- `COMPOSES`: What each tier may compose (its children come from this tier). `components` is the leaf (real UI).
- `LAYOUT`: Universal structural containers — valid at ANY tier; their children stay in the doc's composed tier.
- `AUTH`
- `ECOMMERCE`
- `CRM`
- `BILLING`
- `MARKETING`
- `PREVIEW`
- `PREVIEW_ONLY_MARKER`: The marker every preview-only operation carries; converge keys on it to surface the backdoor.
- `FIRST_PARTY_REGISTRY`
- `STACK_TEMPLATES`
- `MARKETING_COMPONENTS`: The leaf marketing components (app-provided UI). Registered so a section's block may reference them.
- `PROVIDER_CATALOG`: The catalog of swappable implementations per facet. First-party bindings carry their `@suluk` package.

## @suluk/cloudflare

### API

- `provisionD1`: Create-or-get a D1 database by name.
- `queryD1`: Run SQL against a D1 database (D1 accepts multiple `;`-separated statements per call).
- `d1Rows`: Rows from a D1 query response — the API returns `[{ results, success, meta }]` (one per statement); take the last.
- `kvGet`: Read a KV value (raw); null when the key is absent.
- `kvPut`: Write a KV value (optional TTL in seconds).
- `kvDelete`: Delete a KV key.
- `kvList`: List KV keys (optionally by prefix) — returns the key names.
- `applyMigrations`: Apply D1 migrations with a LEDGER (`_suluk_migrations`) so each runs exactly once — the missing piece that makes a
redeploy safe.
- `provisionKvNamespace`: Create-or-get a Workers KV namespace by title (e.g. a sessions or rate-limit store).
- `provisionR2Bucket`: Create-or-get an R2 bucket by name (e.g. media/upload storage).
- `putSecret`: Set ONE Worker secret (an encrypted `secret_text` binding). The script must already exist.
- `putSecrets`: Set many secrets, skipping empty/undefined values; returns the names actually set.
- `resolveZoneId`: Resolve a zone id from its apex host (e.g. `example.com`). Throws when the token can't see the zone.
- `ensureWwwRedirect`: Ensure a www→apex 301 redirect (path + query preserved) on the zone. Idempotent (dedup by rule description).
- `removeWwwRedirect`: Remove the suluk www→apex redirect rule from the zone (leaves any other redirect rules intact).
- `uploadAssets`: Upload a set of static assets; returns the completion JWT for the worker metadata, or `null` when there are none.
- `assetHash`: The Workers-Assets manifest hash: the first 32 hex chars (16 bytes) of the contents' SHA-256.
- `extractAssetRuleFiles`: Pull `_headers` / `_redirects` OUT of an asset list.
- `deployWorker`
- `putCronTriggers`: Set the cron triggers for a script (separate endpoint — metadata doesn't carry them).
- `deploy`: Orchestrate a full deploy over a client + plan. `log` narrates each step.
- `deployWith`: Convenience: build a client from token/account options and run a deploy.
- `kvRateLimitStore`: Build a KV-backed RateLimitStore.
- `memoryRateLimitStore`: A per-instance in-memory fixed-window store — the fail-open fallback (DEV only / KV-blip; not cross-isolate).
- `CloudflareClient`: `@suluk/cloudflare` — API-driven provisioning + deployment for a Suluk app on Cloudflare, no wrangler CLI.
- `CloudflareError`: `@suluk/cloudflare` — API-driven provisioning + deployment for a Suluk app on Cloudflare, no wrangler CLI.

### Types

- `D1Database`
- `KvNamespace`
- `Migration`
- `AssetFile`: One asset: its server path (e.g. "/index.html"), bytes, and content type.
- `UploadSession`
- `AssetRuleFiles`: The result of splitting Workers-Assets rule files out of an asset list.
- `WorkerBinding`
- `WorkerMigration`: A Durable Object migration, INLINE in the script-upload metadata (NOT the D1 `Migration` in resources.

- `DeployResult`
- `DeployLog`

- `ConsumeResult`
- `KvLike`: The slice of the Workers KV API this needs (get/put with TTL).

## @suluk/cockpit

### API

- `validateSource`: Parse + meta-schema validate a document source. Parse failure → a single error diagnostic.

## @suluk/core

### API

- `parseDocument`: Parse a Suluk v4 document from YAML or JSON source text. (YAML is a superset; JSON parses as YAML too.)
- `validateDocument`: Validate a document's STRUCTURE against the v4 meta-schema (SPEC §1, ADRs C003/C004/C009/C013).
- `isValidDocument`: Type guard: a parsed doc that validates is treated as an OpenAPIv4Document.
- `isReference`: Structural guard for an OpenAPI Reference Object (C019 §A.
- `resolveRef`: Resolve a same-document OpenAPI reference "#/components/<type>/<name>" BY NAME (C019 §A.
- `deref`: Resolve a value that may itself be a Reference (one hop). Returns the value unchanged if it is not a Reference.
- `sourceIndex`: The DERIVED reverse index: source pointer → the operations projected from it.
- `sourceCoverage`: Count of operations carrying a source pointer vs total — the provenance-coverage gauge.
- `scrubSource`: Return a CLONE of the document with every `x-suluk-source` removed — for externally published projections, where
a source pointer is internal-layou...
- `sourceKey`: "<file>#<symbol>" — the canonical string key for a source pointer.
- `rateLimitOf`: Read the declared rate-limit facet off an operation.
- `rateLimitIndex`: The DERIVED index: every operation that declares a rate-limit budget + its config.
- `rateLimitCoverage`: Coverage gauge: operations declaring a budget vs total — the rate-limit-coverage counterpart to `sourceCoverage`.
- `retryAfterSeconds`: Retry-After seconds for a budget — `ceil(windowMs / 1000)`, ported from saastarter route-handler.
- `isProblemDetails`: Structural guard — discriminates a Problem Details body (parallel to saastarter's `isApiError` and core's
`isReference`).
- `toProblemDetails`: Pure constructor: a tag (+ optional detail/instance/errors/type) → the canonical Problem Details body.
- `compileTemplate`
- `matchPath`: Reverse-parse: match a concrete URL path against the template.
- `variableCount`: Number of variable segments (for concrete-over-variable precedence ranking).
- `computeSignature`: Compute a request's canonical signature tuple + deterministic key string (C019 §A.2).
- `collide`: Pairwise three-valued collision predicate (C003 detect-and-tolerate; NOT a gate).
- `buildAda`: Build the ADA from a parsed document: index every request, compute signatures, detect collisions.
- `matchRequest`: Match a concrete HTTP request (method + URL) to zero-or-one operation (CONFORMANCE §B.
- `parseQuery`: Parse a raw query string into the form-style key→values map (C019 §A.3 default; repeated keys → array).
- `RATELIMIT_EXT`: The vendor-extension key under which an operation declares its rate budget.
- `PROBLEM_CONTENT_TYPE`: RFC-9457 media type for a Problem Details body.
- `PROBLEM_STATUS_TABLE`: typed-throw → HTTP status, ported verbatim from saastarter route-handler.
- `TITLE_BY_TAG`: Human-readable `title` per tag (RFC-9457 §3.
- `PROBLEM_DETAILS_SCHEMA`: The canonical JSON Schema (2020-12) form of ProblemDetails — the `$ref` target @suluk/hono's emit
injects into `components.

- `SchemaProperty`: The PROPERTY-LEVEL facet locus (saastarter-parity Phase 0).

paths[*]/webhooks/x-suluk-jobs operation (never an in...
- `SulukAgentRef`: A by-name reference to a sub-agent within the same `x-suluk-agents` map (C009/C013; resolved at projection time, never by the matcher).
- `SulukPolicy`: An OPERATOR governance policy (C028) — a member of the `x-suluk-policy` map, keyed by operator/fleet name.
- `SulukResource`: A loadable RESOURCE (C036) — a member of the top-level `x-suluk-resources` catalog.
- `SulukResourceRef`: A by-name reference to a loadable resource within the same `x-suluk-resources` catalog (C036; resolved at projection, never by the matcher; mirrors...
- `SulukStore`: A REACTIVE-STORE declaration (C037) — the per-operation `x-suluk-store` facet.
- `SulukNotifyPolicy`: The document-level `x-suluk-notify` policy (C037) — a status→severity map driving the `@suluk/sdk` callback layer.
- `SulukNotifySeverity`: A status→severity entry value for SulukNotifyPolicy (C037) — how loudly the generated client surfaces a response.

- `RateLimitGroup`
- `ProblemDetails`: An RFC-9457 Problem Details object.
- `ProblemStatus`: The HTTP statuses the error model can produce.

- `settlementOf`: The settlement declared on an operation's cost.
- `settlementAudit`: Audit that every PRICED operation names HOW it is settled, and that the named lever is coherent — the generic form of
toolfactory's "cost names a l...
- `impliedErrorStatuses`: The HTTP error statuses a request's FACETS imply (the generic form of toolfactory's errors-gate): a contract should
declare these responses.
- `settlementRollup`: A quick "how is this API monetized" tally — ops grouped by settlement method (+ priced-but-unsettled).
- `annotateCosts`: Annotate a v4 document in place-safe (returns a new doc): set x-suluk-cost on each named operation (incl. webhooks).
- `costOf`: Read the cost model declared on an operation (if any).
- `costAudit`: Cost-coverage audit: which operations have NOT declared what they cost — plus (C024) the background-cost
disciplines: a deferred cost that resolves...
- `costTable`: The declared costs across the document (paths + webhooks + jobs), for display (the cockpit/admin show this raw).
- `computeCost`: Compute the actual µ$ a request cost, from its declared model + the usage the handler reported.
- `eachOperation`: Every named operation in the document — path requests AND C018 webhooks (which are Requests carrying facets) —
as {path, name, req}.
- `eachJob`: Every background JOB (C025) on the document, as {path, name, job} — non-HTTP cron/queue work.
- `triggerOf`: The trigger an operation's cost declares (C024; default "synchronous").
- `isDeferredCost`: Does this cost accrue on a BACKGROUND event (a non-synchronous trigger) rather than the declaring op's own run?
- `costMeter`: Hono middleware: after the handler runs, record what the request cost (declared model + reported usage).
- `recordUsage`: A handler calls this to report MEASURED third-party usage for the current request (e.g. tokens used).
- `resolveEventExpression`: Resolve a C018 runtime-expression against a fired event.
- `attributePrincipal`: Resolve the principal charged for a fired event per the model's attribution strategy.
- `eventCostEvent`: Build the CostEvent for a FIRED background event — pure.
- `recordEventCost`: Record a fired event's cost into a sink, deduped by its `dedupeKey` against `seen` (so at-least-once delivery
can't double-charge).
- `reconciledAmount`: Resolve the ACTUAL charged amount (in µ$) from the event when the model is `payload-reconciled` (C026), else
undefined.
- `summarize`
- `principalCost`: What ONE principal cost you (the question that lets you price them) — and the trace by operation + action.
- `MemoryCostSink`: A simple in-memory sink (for the demo / tests). Production swaps in D1, a queue, etc.
- `UNATTRIBUTED`: The principal sentinel for a background cost that resolved to NO principal — billed to nobody, but never silent.
- `COST_EXT`

## @suluk/credits

### API

- `getBalance`: Current balance = sum of all ledger deltas for the user.
- `record`: Append one ledger row (the single writer); returns the new row id. `delta` is + on grant/top-up, − on debit.
- `recordKey`: Attribute a debit row to the API KEY that spent it (per-key usage + limit join).
- `debitIfCovers`: ATOMIC metered debit — append `-amount` ONLY IF the balance still covers it, in ONE conditional INSERT (atomic on both
bun:sqlite and D1), then bes...
- `keySpend`: Total credits a key has spent — SUM(abs(delta)) over its attributed DEBITS (delta < 0). Drives the per-key cap + the
 keys-page usage column.
- `nonceFor`: The DETERMINISTIC ledger row id an idempotent operation maps to — exported so a caller can pre-check existence at the
 SAME id debitOnceIfCovers wi...
- `debitOnceIfCovers`: Idempotent atomic debit: debit `amount` ONLY if the balance covers it AND this exact logical operation (identified by
`idemKey`) hasn't already bee...
- `debitOnceAttributed`: Idempotent debit + per-key ATTRIBUTION — the money primitive a per-item bulk charge needs (debitOnceIfCovers
itself does NOT attribute).
- `ledgerRow`: The signed credit `delta` + recorded `amountCents` for ONE ledger row id, or null if absent.
- `recordAmount`: Annotate a ledger row with the CASH that moved (signed). Idempotent (PK on txnId), best-effort (purely cosmetic). No-op on 0/null.
- `listTransactions`: The user's recent ledger rows (grants + debits) with the cash that moved, newest first — the "recent transactions" +
 the activity log.
- `ledgerStats`: Aggregate ledger stats (granted vs spent, outstanding) — the generic part of an admin dashboard.
- `grantOnce`: Idempotent money-IN grant — credit `amount` exactly once, keyed on the ledger row id `idemKey` (a STABLE per-payment
anchor: `pi:<id>` / `inv:<id>`...
- `addCredits`: Grant/top-up credits. Returns the new balance.
- `debitCredits`: Debit credits if the balance covers it; throws InsufficientCreditsError otherwise.
- `InsufficientCreditsError`: `@suluk/credits` — a metered credit ledger (C046, extracted verbatim).
- `creditTransaction`
- `creditAmount`
- `creditKey`

### Types

- `CreditsDB`: The injected DB handle. Prod is drizzle/d1; tests bridge drizzle/bun-sqlite to this type (a runtime-identity narrow).
- `DebitOutcome`: The outcome of an idempotent debit attempt (see debitOnceIfCovers).
- `LedgerEntry`: One ledger row as a panel shows it (`createdAt` epoch-ms).
- `LedgerStats`: `@suluk/credits` — a metered credit ledger (C046, extracted verbatim).

## @suluk/deploy

### API

- `schemaToSql`: A full schema.sql for the app's entities.
- `createTable`: CREATE TABLE for one entity (or a manual-define comment for a $ref/boolean schema).
- `entityColumns`: The columns of an entity, in DDL order (id is a synthesized autoincrement PK when absent). [] for a $ref/boolean.
- `columnDdl`: The DDL fragment for one column.
- `tableName`: The SQLite table name for an entity.
- `migrationSql`: The SQL to migrate from `prev` entities to `next` entities — additive only.

## @suluk/drizzle

### API

- `tableMetadata`: Read a drizzle table's metadata.
- `pascalCase`: "user_accounts" / "users" → "UserAccounts" / "Users". The v4 component key (C009 by-name).
- `tableComponentName`: A drizzle table's PascalCase component name, derived from its SQL name.
- `tableSchemas`: Build the select / insert / update Zod schemas for a table.
update = insert.partial() — the canonical PATCH body (any subset of writable columns).
- `tableToV4`: Lift a table's three Zod schemas to v4 Schema Objects via zodToV4.
- `tableToV4Warnings`: Same conversion as tableToV4 but also returns the enumerated lossy boundary (per-projection
zodToV4 warnings).
- `tableComponents`: Build a v4 components.
- `tableComponentsAudit`: Like tableComponents but enumerates name collisions instead of dropping them silently.
- `crudRoutes`: Generate the five conventional CRUD RouteContracts for a drizzle table:
  - list   GET    {base}            → 200 array(select)
  - get    GET    {...
- `listQuerySchema`: The Zod query schema for a list route: page/perPage/sort/order/q (coerced from strings).
- `parseListQuery`: Normalize a raw query object into a ListQuery — pure, validating against the table's real columns:
page/perPage are clamped (≥1, ≤maxPerPage); `sor...
- `softDeleteValues`: The patch a soft delete applies — sets the deletedAt column to `now` (default current time).
- `anonymizeValues`: The patch an anonymize-on-delete applies — redacts each named column to `value` (null by default).
- `touchTimestamps`: The patch server-managed timestamps apply on write — `updatedAt` always, `createdAt` only when `creating`.
- `notSoftDeleted`: The implicit list filter for a soft-deleting table — exclude rows whose deletedAt is set (unless asked to include).
- `tableDDL`: `CREATE TABLE` DDL for one drizzle table (or its already-read metadata).
- `schemaDDL`: `CREATE TABLE` DDL for many tables, newline-joined — the dev-schema twin of the prod migrations.
- `crudHandlers`: Build the five gated CRUD handlers for a drizzle table. The dev + worker callers differ ONLY in `opts.db`.
- `rowsChanged`: The number of rows a write affected, normalized across drivers (0 when unknown).
- `claimOnce`: Atomically CLAIM a transition: `UPDATE table SET set WHERE where`, returning true iff this call changed a row.
- `claimRows`: Atomically CLAIM a SET of rows and RETURN them: `UPDATE table SET set WHERE where RETURNING *`.

- `AnyTable`: Any drizzle table object accepted by getTableColumns/getTableName.
- `ColumnMeta`: One column's metadata, lifted from drizzle's column descriptor (verified against drizzle-orm 0.45).

## @suluk/env

### API

- `keygen`: Generate an ML-KEM-768 keypair. Pass a 64-byte seed only for deterministic/test keygen.
- `encrypt`: Seal a plaintext value to a public key → an `encrypted:mlkem768:…` token.
- `decrypt`: Open an `encrypted:mlkem768:…` token with the private key. Throws if the key is wrong or the token is tampered.
- `isEncrypted`: Is this value an `encrypted:…` token (vs plaintext)?
- `publicFromPrivate`: Derive the public key string from a private key (so `set`/`encrypt` work given only the secret).
- `parseEnv`: Parse .env content → an ordered { key, value } record (raw values; encrypted ones stay as tokens).
- `resolveEnv`: Resolve .
- `encryptContent`: Encrypt every plaintext value in the content to `publicKey`, leaving already-encrypted values + the key vars +
comments untouched, and ensuring the...
- `decryptContent`: Decrypt every encrypted value in the content with `privateKey` → plaintext file content (for inspection).
- `loadEnv`: Resolve + inject. Returns the decrypted { KEY: value } record that was loaded.
- `defineEnv`
- `SCHEME`: The cipher/key scheme tag embedded in keys + tokens. Bump if the construction ever changes.
- `PUBLIC_KEY_NAME`
- `PRIVATE_KEY_NAME`

## @suluk/i18n

### API

- `defineLocales`: Define an app's locale set.
- `localeCodes`: All declared codes, in order.
- `isSupportedLocale`: Is `code` a declared locale?
- `dirOf`: The writing direction for a locale (default "ltr" — an unknown code is treated as ltr).
- `resolveLocale`: Resolve a candidate (cookie value, query param, negotiated pick) to a supported locale, else the default.
- `readCookie`: Read one cookie's value out of a Cookie header string (Workers-safe — no `next/headers`).
- `localeFromCookie`: Resolve the locale from a `locale` cookie in a Cookie header (Workers-safe).
- `negotiateLocale`: Negotiate the best supported locale from an `Accept-Language` header (q-weighted; exact then primary-subtag match).
- `localeFromRequest`: Resolve the locale for a standard Request: the `locale` cookie wins; else negotiate from `Accept-Language`.
- `t`: Interpolate `{token}` params into a message; an unknown key falls back to the key itself.
Ported verbatim from saastarter i18n.ts:195-207.
- `translator`: Bind a catalog so callers write `tt("key", { name })` instead of threading the catalog every call.
- `loadMessages`: Load a namespace's catalog for a locale, falling back to the DEFAULT locale's chunk when the locale is missing
(saastarter's `nsLoaders[locale] ?
- `gradeCompleteness`: Grade a locale catalog against the default catalog — the runtime, harden-style completeness gauge that complements
the compile-time key-parity types.
- `formatNumber`: Format a number for a locale — honors its numberingSystem (e.g. "arab" → ٠١٢٣).
- `formatCurrency`: Format a MONEY amount.
- `formatDate`: Format a date/time for a locale (honors the numbering system for numeric date parts).

default's keys (no missing, no extra).

## @suluk/keys

### API

- `expiredAncestor`: TRUE when any ANCESTOR (a node other than the caller) has already expired — so the caller auto-expires the moment a
 parent does.
- `disabledAncestor`: TRUE when any ANCESTOR has been soft-disabled — so a child auto-dies the moment a parent is revoked, EVEN when the
 revocation didn't cascade throu...
- `pooledHeadroom`: The chain's POOLED credit headroom — the BINDING constraint a charge must clear: over every node that declares an own
cap, the LEAST `cap − subtree...
- `topCappedPath`: The topmost capped node in a chain (the shortest path) — whose subtree contains every other capped node's subtree, so
 one query over it suffices f...
- `clampChildGrant`: Clamp a requested CHILD grant to the parent's EFFECTIVE grant — a child can never out-scope or out-spend an ancestor.
- `escapeLike`: Escape SQL-LIKE metacharacters (a keyId can contain `_`, a LIKE wildcard) so a path prefix matches LITERALLY — pair
 with `ESCAPE '\'` in the query.
- `subtreeLikePattern`: The `LIKE` pattern for "<path>'s strict descendants" — pair with `ESCAPE '\'`. (The node itself is matched by `= path`.)
- `inSubtree`: TRUE when `candidate` is within `path`'s subtree: the node itself (exact) OR a descendant (a "/"-prefix).
- `childPath`: A child's path = `parentPath/childId`, or the bare `childId` when the parent is a root (no path / a session caller).
- `pathDepth`: Depth of a path: 0 = root, >0 = a delegated child.
- `ancestorIdsOf`: The ancestor keyIds in a path (everything before self), root→parent order.
- `pathAt`: The own-path of the ancestor at index `i` in a path's segments (the prefix up to and including it).
- `parseScopes`: permissions JSON (`{resource:[actions]}`) → flat `["resource:action"]` scopes, defensively (a bad value → no scopes).
- `parseKeyMeta`: metadata JSON → the per-key controls (each null when absent/invalid): the PAID credit cap + the rate-limit share %.
- `subtreeOf`: The keyIds in a node's subtree (itself + every descendant) — for cascade revoke.
- `parentPathOf`: A parent's materialized path (for building a child's path).
- `insertLineage`: Record a freshly-minted child (or root, when parentKeyId is null) in the lineage tree. Idempotent on the keyId PK.
- `chainHeadroom`: The chain's POOLED credit headroom — one grouped query over the TOPMOST capped node's subtree (joining the credit
ledger via the `credit_key` sidec...
- `revokeKeyTree`: Cascade-revoke a key's subtree: compute the api-key ids in `keyId`'s subtree (a keyed caller may revoke ONLY a STRICT
descendant of itself — not it...
- `MAX_KEY_DEPTH`: A delegation chain can be at most this deep (root..leaf) — bounds the path length + the per-request walk.
- `keyLineage`: The delegation tree: each node's parent + a materialized `path` of keyIds (root→…→self).

## Optional

### Types

- `ChainNode`: One node of a caller's chain — itself or an ancestor — with its OWN (pre-chain) grant + caps + its materialized path.
- `EffectiveCaps`: `@suluk/keys` — the delegation-chain ALGEBRA for hierarchical API keys (C046, extracted from a real app).
- `SpendRow`: One row of per-path spend (a positive amount), as the app's subtree query returns it.
- `Headroom`: `@suluk/keys` — the delegation-chain ALGEBRA for hierarchical API keys (C046, extracted from a real app).
- `KeysDB`: The injected DB handle (drizzle/d1 in prod; bun:sqlite bridged in tests).

## @suluk/payments

### API

- `paymentClient`: The Prism-style entry point: read the single processor named in `config.
- `stripePost`
- `stripeGet`
- `toForm`: Stripe's bracket-nested `x-www-form-urlencoded` encoder: objects → `key[k]`, arrays → `key[i]`, scalars appended;
 undefined/null are skipped.
- `subtotal`: Subtotal in cents — integer, non-negative.
- `computeDiscountAmount`: The cents a discount removes from `subtotalCents` — ROUNDED to a whole cent and CLAMPED to [0, subtotal] so a
discount can never exceed the order o...
- `validateDiscount`: Validate a discount against a subtotal, with a SPECIFIC rejection reason (PARITY: "specific discount-rejection
reasons" — a shopper is told *why*, ...
- `prorateDiscount`: Split `discountCents` across `lines` proportionally to each line's total, as whole cents that sum EXACTLY to
`discountCents` (largest-remainder app...
- `orderTotal`: Compose the authoritative order total from lines + an optional (already-validated) discount.
- `composeTotal`: Fold every component into ONE authoritative total: subtotal − discount + shipping + tax, each a non-negative whole
cent and the discount never exce...
- `verifyAmount`: ANTI-TAMPERING: recompute the total from authoritative line prices + the discount and compare it to the amount
the client claims (e.
- `cartFingerprint`: A stable fingerprint of the priced cart (+ discount) — order-independent over lines.
- `idempotencyKey`: A deterministic idempotency key for a checkout attempt.
- `requiresStripe`: Does this total require a real Stripe charge, or can it complete as a free order?
- `verifyStripeSignature`: Verify a Stripe `stripe-signature` header against the raw request body + the endpoint signing secret.
- `timingSafeHexEqual`: Constant-time hex-string compare (no early-out) — guards the signature check against timing oracles.
- `webhookRouter`: Build a router, optionally seeded with a `{ type → handler }` map.
- `IntegrationError`: Request-phase: bad/missing config, a missing required field, a serialization failure. The caller's bug to fix.
- `ConnectorError`: Response-phase: the processor returned an unexpected shape the connector couldn't transform.
- `NetworkError`: Transport: timeout, connection refused, DNS failure — may recover on retry.
- `PaymentLibError`: The error taxonomy (C048) — mirrors Prism's three hard-failure classes.
- `Currency`: ISO-4217 currency. A curated set for `Currency.USD`-style access; open to any code a connector accepts.
- `mockConnector`
- `MOCK_DECLINE_CARD`: Well-known test PANs (Stripe-compatible values, for familiarity).
- `MOCK_3DS_CARD`
- `stripeConnector`
- `STRIPE_MIN_CHARGE_CENTS`: Stripe's minimum chargeable amount (USD). Below it, a charge is impossible — the order must go the free path.
- `STRIPE_EVENTS`: The common Stripe checkout/billing event types (for discoverability + typo-safe registration).

## @suluk/provision

### API

- `defineProvision`: Validate + return a provision config.
- `topoOrder`: Order `instances` so each comes after its binding producers.
- `parseRef`: Parse a single value: a `@ref.key` string → its parts, else null (not a reference).
- `depsOf`: Every instance ref a spec's params depend on (deduped) — the spec's in-edges in the DAG.
- `resolveParams`: Resolve a spec's params against the accumulated outputs (ref → its output map).
- `stableStringify`: A stable JSON string (recursively sorted keys) — order-independent so a fingerprint is reproducible.
- `fingerprint`: The drift fingerprint of a desired instance = a stable hash of (name + plan + params).
- `plan`: Diff `config` against `state`.
- `apply`: Execute the plan for `config`. Idempotent end-to-end: re-running a settled config is all-noops, touches no provider.
- `pollToDone`: Poll an async operation to a terminal state. Throws on "failed" or after `timeoutMs`.
- `checkDrift`: Report whether live state matches the config (orphans counted only when pruning is the config default).
- `assertNoDrift`: Fail-closed: throw when there's any drift (the CI gate).
- `pull`: Fetch each journaled instance's live state via its broker (OSB fetch) → an external-drift report. Read-only.
- `reconcile`: Fold a pull report into the journal: DROP externally-deleted instances (so the next `apply` re-creates them) + MERGE
 live outputs over drifted one...
- `discover`: Discover live instances (via `broker.
- `teardown`: Deprovision the whole journal, consumers-first, honouring `protected`. Destructive — gate it behind confirmation.
- `snapshot`: A snapshot of `config` at migration `idx`.
- `diffSnapshots`: Diff the previous snapshot against the next (current) config → the ordered migration steps.
- `migrationTag`: `NNNN_name` — the zero-padded migration tag.
- `memoryMigrationStore`: An in-memory migration store (tests / dry-runs).
- `fileMigrationStore`: A file-backed migration store rooted at `dir` (default `provision/`).
- `generate`
- `migrate`
- `memoryStore`: A StateStore over an in-memory array (cloned on load/save so callers can't mutate the journal by reference).
- `memorySink`: A BindingSink that records every (envVar → value) it lands — for assertions + a dry-run "what would be set" preview.
- `fileStore`
- `envSink`: A BindingSink that persists bindings into a `.env` via @suluk/env (encrypted by default; commit-safe).
- `cloudflareD1`: D1 database.
- `cloudflareKv`: Workers KV namespace. Provision is create-or-get. Output: `namespace_id`.
- `cloudflareR2`: R2 bucket. Provision is create-or-get. Output: `bucket_name` (R2's id IS its name).
- `cloudflareSecrets`: Worker secrets — the runtime-secret SINK as a broker (this is `sync-secrets.
- `cloudflareToken`: A scoped, least-privilege Cloudflare API token (this is `mint-service-tokens.
- `cloudflareWwwRedirect`: A www → apex 301 redirect (C058) on the zone of `params.
- `cloudflarePagesDomain`
- `defineProvisionApp`: Validate + return a provision app config (the CLI imports this as the config file's default export).
- `runCli`
- `EMPTY_SNAPSHOT`: The empty baseline — the "before the first migration" state, so the first `generate` diffs against nothing.
- `SNAPSHOT_VERSION`

## @suluk/stripe

### API

- `subtotal`: Subtotal in cents — integer, non-negative.
- `computeDiscountAmount`: The cents a discount removes from `subtotalCents` — ROUNDED to a whole cent and CLAMPED to [0, subtotal] so a
discount can never exceed the order o...
- `validateDiscount`: Validate a discount against a subtotal, with a SPECIFIC rejection reason (PARITY: "specific discount-rejection
reasons" — a shopper is told *why*, ...
- `prorateDiscount`: Split `discountCents` across `lines` proportionally to each line's total, as whole cents that sum EXACTLY to
`discountCents` (largest-remainder app...
- `orderTotal`: Compose the authoritative order total from lines + an optional (already-validated) discount.
- `composeTotal`: Fold every component into ONE authoritative total: subtotal − discount + shipping + tax, each a non-negative whole
cent and the discount never exce...
- `verifyAmount`: ANTI-TAMPERING: recompute the total from authoritative line prices + the discount and compare it to the amount
the client claims (e.
- `cartFingerprint`: A stable fingerprint of the priced cart (+ discount) — order-independent over lines.
- `idempotencyKey`: A deterministic idempotency key for a checkout attempt.
- `requiresStripe`: Does this total require a real Stripe charge, or can it complete as a free order?
- `verifyStripeSignature`: Verify a Stripe `stripe-signature` header against the raw request body + the endpoint signing secret.
- `timingSafeHexEqual`: Constant-time hex-string compare (no early-out) — guards the signature check against timing oracles.
- `webhookRouter`: Build a router, optionally seeded with a `{ type → handler }` map.
- `toForm`: Stripe's bracket-nested `x-www-form-urlencoded` encoder: objects → `key[k]`, arrays → `key[i]`, scalars appended;
 undefined/null are skipped.
- `stripePost`
- `stripeGet`
- `STRIPE_MIN_CHARGE_CENTS`: Stripe's minimum chargeable amount (USD). Below it, a charge is impossible — the order must go the free path.
- `STRIPE_EVENTS`: The common Stripe checkout/billing event types (for discoverability + typo-safe registration).

## Optional

### Types

- `CartLine`: One cart line. `unitCents` is the authoritative price (from the server, not the client).
- `Discount`: A discount's MATH shape (the structural part; app-side eligibility rules are separate).
- `DiscountResult`
- `DiscountRejection`
- `OrderTotal`
- `OrderTotalFull`: The full order total once shipping + tax (from the ./shipping + ./tax adapters) are known.
- `AmountVerdict`
- `StripeWebhookEvent`: A verified webhook event — only `type` is required (the router dispatches on it); `data` carries the payload.
- `WebhookHandler`
- `WebhookRouter`
- `HandleResult`

## @suluk/theme

### API

- `oklch`: Construct an OKLCH color (clamped to valid ranges).
- `clampOklch`: Clamp to valid ranges: l∈[0,1], c≥0, h wrapped to [0,360), alpha∈[0,1]. Non-finite inputs collapse to 0.
- `formatOklch`: Format as a CSS `oklch(L C H)` / `oklch(L C H / A)` string.
- `parseOklch`: Parse a CSS `oklch(L C H)` / `oklch(L C H / A)` string. Percentages on L are normalized (50% → 0.5). Null on miss.
- `withLightness`: A copy with a new lightness (kept in [0,1]).
- `withAlpha`: A copy with a new alpha.
- `cssVarName`: The CSS custom-property name for a color role (kebab-cased: primaryForeground → --primary-foreground).
- `deriveDark`: Derive a dark TokenSpec from a light one (colors remapped; radius/fonts/scales carried through).
- `themeFromLight`: Build a complete {light, dark} ThemeSpec, deriving dark when not supplied.
- `parseShadcnCss`: Parse a shadcn/tweakcn theme CSS string into light + dark ColorTokens.
- `toCssVars`: A scheme's CSS custom properties — the colors (OKLCH) + radius + any fonts/shadows/scales — under one selector.
- `toThemeCss`: Both modes as CSS: light at :root, dark at the dark selector.
- `toTailwindTheme`: The Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` block — maps each token to its utility variable (`--color-background`,
`--radius-lg`, `--font-sans`, breakpoints) r...
- `toShadcnTokens`: The shadcn token map: CSS-var name → OKLCH value (+ --radius). What a shadcn `components.json`/globals consumes.
- `renderBaseCss`: The reusable design-system BASE layer — the accessibility + motion contract every builder inherits, independent
of the scheme colors.
- `COLOR_ROLES`: the color roles, in CSS-var order — the single list emit + derive iterate.
- `graphite`: Neutral graphite (saastarter's default scheme name) — a chroma-free brand.
- `terracotta`: Terracotta — saastarter's signature accent (globals.css oklch(0.6397 0.172 36.44)).
- `ocean`: Ocean — a cool blue brand, to show a colored hue derives correctly.
- `REFERENCE_SCHEMES`: The reference set, keyed by name.

## Optional

### Types

- `Oklch`: The OKLCH value type (saastarter-parity Phase 1).
- `ColorTokens`: The shadcn color-token roles (each a foreground/surface pair where applicable).
- `FontTokens`
- `TokenSpec`: One mode's tokens (light or dark).
- `ThemeSpec`: A complete scheme: the light mode + its dark mode (authored, or derived via deriveDark).

## @suluk/visual

### API

- `hash`: Stable, fast, non-cryptographic hash (djb2) of source text or raw bytes — for change detection only.
- `checkConfidence`: Decide, WITHOUT rendering, whether a UI built from `used` primitives is pixel-confident given the baseline.
- `pendingVerification`: Exactly the primitives that need a (one-time) pixel verification right now: the missing + the drifted.
- `approve`: Record approvals into the baseline (the "verify once"): each capture marks its primitive verified-at-hash.
- `confidenceCoverage`: Coverage = fraction of used primitives that are approved + unchanged. 1 ⇒ fully pixel-confident.
- `formPrimitives`: The distinct primitives a generated FORM is composed of: its layout + each widget it uses.
- `tablePrimitives`: The distinct primitives a generated TABLE is composed of: its layout + the cell primitive.
- `renderPrimitiveHtml`: A self-contained HTML page that renders exactly one primitive — the thing you screenshot to approve it.
- `knownWidgets`: The widget primitives this package knows how to render in isolation (for the verify-once gate).
- `primitiveControl`: Just the control fragment (no surrounding page) — for an inline preview in a host UI (the cockpit webview).
- `primitiveCss`: A small stylesheet for the control fragments above — so a host can render `primitiveControl` inline.
- `contentHash`: Hash of the render-affecting source of a primitive (its component code, variant, tokens).
- `snapshotHash`: Hash of an approved screenshot's bytes — the recorded identity of "what was verified".

## Optional

### Types

- `Baseline`: The approved baseline — primitive key → its verified entry. Persist as JSON; commit it.
- `BaselineEntry`: `@suluk/visual` — pixel-confidence by construction.
- `UsedPrimitive`: A primitive USED by a generated UI: its key + the CURRENT content hash of its source.
- `ConfidenceReport`: `@suluk/visual` — pixel-confidence by construction.
- `Capture`: A capture from the verify-once gate: the primitive, its content hash, and its approved screenshot's hash.
- `PrimitiveSources`

- `v4ToZod`: Convert a v4 Schema Object to a Zod schema.

- `lexicalSchema`: The serialized Lexical editor state — `{ root: { children: [...] } }`. The storage shape of a richtext field.
- `lexicalNodeSchema`: A single Lexical node — recursive + open (each node type carries its own extra fields; we keep the common ones).
- `LEXICAL_V4_SCHEMA`: The v4 (JSON Schema 2020-12) projection of a Lexical state — recursive via a `$defs.

## Registry modules (own-the-code backends)

Install with `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add MahmoodKhalil57/suluk/<item>`. Each wires the @suluk packages above.

- [admin](registry/admin/): An Effect-TS Admin service exposing GET /api/admin/stats — the admin-scoped ops/usage aggregate. Wraps @suluk/credits' ledgerStats (credits issued vs spent + outstanding balance stay upstream) + the module-owned credit_transaction row count. Admin-scope is enforced globally by the contract's enforceApiKeyScope on /api/admin, so the route does no gating. A stateless read: no schema, no provision (reads existing tables). Own the wiring, npm the aggregate.
- [app](registry/app/): The base Hono app (error handling + health) plus the Effect-TS `Db` service every feature module depends on. The foundation feature services build on.
- [audit](registry/audit/): Dev/CI tooling (no runtime mount): a single conformance script that consolidates @suluk/cockpit's lifecycle gates + @suluk/harden's input-hardening security grade + schema-fact readiness grade into one unified ship-readiness pass/fail. Loads your v4 contract and exits non-zero when a gate blocks or the combined grade falls below the floor — the one command your pipeline gates on.
- [auth](registry/auth/): The auth foundation: buildAuth (drizzle adapter + openAPI/apiKey/passkey plugins, parametrized), mountAuthRoutes (the Hono handler), and a CurrentUser Effect service. Owns the user + apikey tables. The schema is reconciled against Better Auth v1.6.23 (canonical) — regenerate with `npx @better-auth/cli generate` if you change plugins/version. The signup hook (onUserCreated) wires to the `credits` module.
- [billing](registry/billing/): An Effect-TS Billing service over @suluk/billing (which runs on @suluk/payments' agnostic connector + client-token surface): ensure-customer, Payment-Element + add-card sessions, saved cards, billing portal. The webhook dispatch + pricing matrix stay in your app (C046/C048).
- [contract](registry/contract/): The keystone: declares the base API surface as @suluk/hono RouteContracts (with x-suluk-access scopes + zod request schemas) and DERIVES everything downstream consumes — apiDocument(principal?) (the per-principal v4 doc via emitV4), SCOPE_BY_OP + PUBLIC_OPS (the scope facets the scope gate / MCP read), the enforceApiKeyScope gate, the validateRequest body gate, and GET /api/openapi.json projected to the caller's scopes. Own the wiring, npm the derivation. Stateless — no schema, no provision.
- [cost](registry/cost/): An Effect-TS Cost service over @suluk/cost (the storage-agnostic cost algebra: integer micro-USD, per-source breakdowns, background-event attribution + at-least-once dedup stay upstream). Persists live-request + fired-event costs into D1 and reads the raw ledger picture back (total, by principal/operation/action/source). This module owns the cost_event + cost_dedup tables; the projection logic is npm.
- [credits](registry/credits/): An Effect-TS Credits service (Context.Tag + Layer) wrapping @suluk/credits (the atomic debit CAS + idempotent grant stay upstream), its Hono routes, schema re-export, and a provision fragment for the D1 tables. The hybrid pattern: own the service wiring, npm the money logic.
- [email](registry/email/): An Effect-TS Email service over @suluk/email (the EmailProvider transport, the Resend/console impls, and the branded lifecycle templates stay upstream). Reads the provider config from env, picks console in dev / Resend in prod, and exposes send + verify + reset — wire verify/reset into Better Auth's sendVerificationEmail + sendResetPassword. A stateless binding: no schema, no provision fragment (C052).
- [erasure](registry/erasure/): An Effect-TS Erasure service over @suluk/better-auth's beforeDeleteCascade (the fail-closed GDPR orchestrator — abort rather than half-erase — stays upstream). Runs an ordered delete/anonymize cascade across the core Suluk tables when a user is erased, wireable into Better Auth's deleteUser.beforeDelete hook, and writes an erasure_receipt audit row. You pick the posture (delete vs anonymize) and trim the cascade to the modules you installed.
- [i18n](registry/i18n/): A locale/direction negotiation MIDDLEWARE over @suluk/i18n (the q-weighted Accept-Language matcher, the cookie parser, and the config/direction model stay upstream). Owns only the wiring: the app's default locale set + a Hono middleware that resolves each request's locale (?lang > cookie > Accept-Language) and stashes locale + dir on the context. mountI18n(app) applies it globally via app.use. A stateless binding — no schema, no provision (C052).
- [journeys](registry/journeys/): Dev/CI tooling (no runtime mount): author plain-Gherkin user journeys against the step vocabulary @suluk/journeys projects from your v4 contract, then bind + grade coverage as a bun:test gate. The binder resolves each step exact-or-unbound and grades contract→authored coverage; unbound steps are your worklist. Ships a config, an example feature, and the coverage harness.
- [keys](registry/keys/): An Effect-TS Keys service over @suluk/keys (the abuse-proof pooled-headroom cap + cascade revocation stay upstream): lineage subtree, cascade revoke, and the pooled headroom over a chain. Key creation is Better Auth's apikey plugin (the `auth` module); this manages the delegation tree.
- [logs](registry/logs/): A fully-owned Effect-TS activity log over an append-only table: record an action, read a principal's recent activity. No @suluk logic package — the whole module is yours to extend.
- [mcp](registry/mcp/): The API-as-MCP surface: mounts @suluk/mcp's mcpApp at /api/mcp with the contract's apiDocument(scopes) as the per-caller tool list (a caller only sees the tools its principal can call — the contract-first payoff), executes tools in-process via appExec, exposes the OAuth /.well-known discovery (Better Auth's mcp plugin, enabled in auth via opts.mcp), and manages MCP connections (list/update/revoke; session-only) over an owned mcp_connection table. Own the wiring, npm the protocol + OAuth server.
- [rate-credit](registry/rate-credit/): A credit-backed free-tier rate limiter alongside the fixed-window rate-limit: a per-principal token bucket denominated in µ$ (the same unit as a route's COGS in cost). Each free-tier request debits a small fixed cost; 429 (RFC-9457 via @suluk/core) when the bucket is empty. C052: the µ$ bucket math is app-owned policy (ported here, not a package); only the RFC-9457 envelope is npm. State is one KV binding env.RATE_CREDIT_KV (a binding, not an owned D1 table — no provision fragment). Lazy epoch-ms regen (no cron), FAIL-OPEN on KV error or an unbound namespace. mountRateCredit(app) applies globally after identity resolves; keys by c.var.user?.id else cf-connecting-ip; skips /api/health + /api/webhooks.
- [rate-limit](registry/rate-limit/): A principal-aware rate-limit MIDDLEWARE over @suluk/hono's enforceRateLimit (the fixed-window bucket math, the swappable RateLimitStore, MemoryRateLimitStore, and the 429 + Retry-After RFC-9457 envelope stay upstream). Owns only the wiring: a keyer that keys by the authenticated user id off the Hono context (else client IP) + the store choice (MemoryRateLimitStore in dev; swap a KV/DO-backed store for prod). mountRateLimit(app) applies it globally via app.use. A stateless binding — no schema, no provision (C052).
- [reference](registry/reference/): An API reference PAGE rendered by @suluk/reference (the complete v4-native renderer: cost badges, access View-as projection, hardening, try-it) over apiDocument() — the SAME per-principal v4 document the contract keystone derives. GET /api/reference renders the full doc; GET /api/reference/:tool projects it to one operation (by its by-name handle). Own the wiring, npm the renderer. Derived + stateless — no schema, no provision.
- [webhooks](registry/webhooks/): An Effect-TS Webhooks service over @suluk/payments' inbound Stripe surface (SDK-free HMAC-SHA256 signature verification + a typed event router stay upstream). Verifies the RAW request body against the stripe-signature header + the signing secret, dedups on the Stripe event id against an owned webhook_event table (Stripe is at-least-once, so redelivery is a no-op), then routes the verified event through webhookRouter. Ships a documented STUB handler set the app fills with fulfillment (e.g. credits.grant) — kept decoupled from @suluk/credits. Owns the webhook_event table; verification + routing is npm.

## Platform assembly

`@suluk/platform` (`definePlatform`) + `@suluk/provision` assemble the registry modules into a running backend. The modules platform composes:

  - admin — An Effect-TS Admin service exposing GET /api/admin/stats — the admin-scoped ops/usage aggregate. Wraps @suluk/credits' ledgerStats (credits issued vs spent + outstanding balance stay upstream) + the module-owned credit_transaction row count. Admin-scope is enforced globally by the contract's enforceApiKeyScope on /api/admin, so the route does no gating. A stateless read: no schema, no provision (reads existing tables).   - app — The base Hono app (error handling + health) plus the Effect-TS `Db` service every feature module depends on. The foundation feature services build on.
  - audit — Dev/CI tooling (no runtime mount): a single conformance script that consolidates @suluk/cockpit's lifecycle gates + @suluk/harden's input-hardening security grade + schema-fact readiness grade into one unified ship-readiness pass/fail. Loads your v4 contract and exits non-zero when a gate blocks or the combined grade falls below the floor — the one command your pipeline gates on.
  - auth — The auth foundation: buildAuth (drizzle adapter + openAPI/apiKey/passkey plugins, parametrized), mountAuthRoutes (the Hono handler), and a CurrentUser Effect service. Owns the user + apikey tables. The schema is reconciled against Better Auth v1.6.23 (canonical) — regenerate with `npx @better-auth/cli generate` if you change plugins/version. The signup hook (onUserCreated) wires to the `credits` module.
  - billing — An Effect-TS Billing service over @suluk/billing (which runs on @suluk/payments' agnostic connector + client-token surface): ensure-customer, Payment-Element + add-card sessions, saved cards, billing portal. The webhook dispatch + pricing matrix stay in your app (C046/C048).
  - contract — The keystone: declares the base API surface as @suluk/hono RouteContracts (with x-suluk-access scopes + zod request schemas) and DERIVES everything downstream consumes — apiDocument(principal?) (the per-principal v4 doc via emitV4), SCOPE_BY_OP + PUBLIC_OPS (the scope facets the scope gate / MCP read), the enforceApiKeyScope gate, the validateRequest body gate, and GET /api/openapi.json projected to the caller's scopes. Reads the provider config from env, picks console in dev / Resend in prod, and exposes send + verify + reset — wire verify/reset into Better Auth's sendVerificationEmail + sendResetPassword. A stateless binding: no schema, no provision fragment (C052).
  - erasure — An Effect-TS Erasure service over @suluk/better-auth's beforeDeleteCascade (the fail-closed GDPR orchestrator — abort rather than half-erase — stays upstream). Runs an ordered delete/anonymize cascade across the core Suluk tables when a user is erased, wireable into Better Auth's deleteUser.beforeDelete hook, and writes an erasure_receipt audit row. You pick the posture (delete vs anonymize) and trim the cascade to the modules you installed.
  - i18n — A locale/direction negotiation MIDDLEWARE over @suluk/i18n (the q-weighted Accept-Language matcher, the cookie parser, and the config/direction model stay upstream). Owns only the wiring: the app's default locale set + a Hono middleware that resolves each request's locale (?lang > cookie > Accept-Language) and stashes locale + dir on the context. mountI18n(app) applies it globally via app.use. A stateless binding — no schema, no provision (C052).
  - journeys — Dev/CI tooling (no runtime mount): author plain-Gherkin user journeys against the step vocabulary @suluk/journeys projects from your v4 contract, then bind + grade coverage as a bun:test gate. The binder resolves each step exact-or-unbound and grades contract→authored coverage; unbound steps are your worklist. Ships a config, an example feature, and the coverage harness.
  - keys — An Effect-TS Keys service over @suluk/keys (the abuse-proof pooled-headroom cap + cascade revocation stay upstream): lineage subtree, cascade revoke, and the pooled headroom over a chain. Key creation is Better Auth's apikey plugin (the `auth` module); this manages the delegation tree.
  - logs — A fully-owned Effect-TS activity log over an append-only table: record an action, read a principal's recent activity. No @suluk logic package — the whole module is yours to extend.
  - mcp — The API-as-MCP surface: mounts @suluk/mcp's mcpApp at /api/mcp with the contract's apiDocument(scopes) as the per-caller tool list (a caller only sees the tools its principal can call — the contract-first payoff), executes tools in-process via appExec, exposes the OAuth /.well-known discovery (Better Auth's mcp plugin, enabled in auth via opts.mcp), and manages MCP connections (list/update/revoke; session-only) over an owned mcp_connection table. Own the wiring, npm the protocol + OAuth server.
  - rate-credit — A credit-backed free-tier rate limiter alongside the fixed-window rate-limit: a per-principal token bucket denominated in µ$ (the same unit as a route's COGS in cost). Each free-tier request debits a small fixed cost; 429 (RFC-9457 via @suluk/core) when the bucket is empty. C052: the µ$ bucket math is app-owned policy (ported here, not a package); only the RFC-9457 envelope is npm. State is one KV binding env.RATE_CREDIT_KV (a binding, not an owned D1 table — no provision fragment). Lazy epoch-ms regen (no cron), FAIL-OPEN on KV error or an unbound namespace. mountRateCredit(app) applies globally after identity resolves; keys by c.var.user?.id else cf-connecting-ip; skips /api/health + /api/webhooks.
  - rate-limit — A principal-aware rate-limit MIDDLEWARE over @suluk/hono's enforceRateLimit (the fixed-window bucket math, the swappable RateLimitStore, MemoryRateLimitStore, and the 429 + Retry-After RFC-9457 envelope stay upstream). Owns only the wiring: a keyer that keys by the authenticated user id off the Hono context (else client IP) + the store choice (MemoryRateLimitStore in dev; swap a KV/DO-backed store for prod). mountRateLimit(app) applies it globally via app.use. A stateless binding — no schema, no provision (C052).
  - reference — An API reference PAGE rendered by @suluk/reference (the complete v4-native renderer: cost badges, access View-as projection, hardening, try-it) over apiDocument() — the SAME per-principal v4 document the contract keystone derives. GET /api/reference renders the full doc; GET /api/reference/:tool projects it to one operation (by its by-name handle). Own the wiring, npm the renderer. Derived + stateless — no schema, no provision.
  - webhooks — An Effect-TS Webhooks service over @suluk/payments' inbound Stripe surface (SDK-free HMAC-SHA256 signature verification + a typed event router stay upstream). Verifies the RAW request body against the stripe-signature header + the signing secret, dedups on the Stripe event id against an owned webhook_event table (Stripe is at-least-once, so redelivery is a no-op), then routes the verified event through webhookRouter. Ships a documented STUB handler set the app fills with fulfillment (e.g. credits.grant) — kept decoupled from @suluk/credits. Owns the webhook_event table; verification + routing is npm.
